sentences.en: Yesterday, I did not feel well.
sentences.zh: 昨天，我感觉不舒服。

sentences.en: I had a pain in my head and a fever.
sentences.zh: 我头痛还发烧。

sentences.en: My mother took me to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈带我去了医院。

sentences.en: We waited in the room for a short time.
sentences.zh: 我们在房间里等了一小会儿。

sentences.en: The doctor was a kind man.
sentences.zh: 医生是个和善的人。

sentences.en: He looked at my throat and my ears.
sentences.zh: 他看了看我的喉咙和耳朵。

sentences.en: He said I had a cold and gave me some medicine.
sentences.zh: 他说我感冒了，给了我一些药。

sentences.en: He said, 'Take this medicine after meals.'
sentences.zh: 他说：'饭后服用这种药。'

sentences.en: I went back home and rested in bed.
sentences.zh: 我回家后在床上休息。

sentences.en: Today, I am better than yesterday.
sentences.zh: 今天，我比昨天好多了。

sentences.en: I am still not ready to go out.
sentences.zh: 我还没有准备好出门。

sentences.en: The doctor said I will be well in a few days.
sentences.zh: 医生说几天后我就会好起来。

sentences.en: The medical care at the hospital was very good.
sentences.zh: 医院的医疗护理非常好。

sentences.en: The disease was common in winter.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病在冬天很常见。

sentences.en: I had a cough and a sneeze all day.
sentences.zh: 我整天咳嗽和打喷嚏。

sentences.en: My breathing was not normal, so the doctor gave me a test.
sentences.zh: 我的呼吸不正常，所以医生给我做了检查。

sentences.en: Rest is important for the process of getting well.
sentences.zh: 休息对于康复的过程很重要。

sentences.en: My digestion was poor, so I had to change my food.
sentences.zh: 我的消化不好，所以我必须改变我的饮食。

sentences.en: The operation was done by the chief doctor.
sentences.zh: 手术由主任医生完成。

sentences.en: I was ill for a week with a fever.
sentences.zh: 我发烧病了一周。

sentences.en: The wound on my arm was deep.
sentences.zh: 我手臂上的伤口很深。

sentences.en: The doctor gave a detailed account of the operation.
sentences.zh: 医生详细描述了手术过程。

sentences.en: The destruction of the cells was caused by the disease.
sentences.zh: 细胞的破坏是由疾病引起的。

sentences.en: Every detail of the care was important.
sentences.zh: 护理的每一个细节都很重要。
